purpose: Record a bounded rooted geometry-graph projection for the exact ACIS 21500 row profile observed in one hash-pinned AC1024 inline SAB.

source.priorEvidence: The inline SAB and parser framing details are documented in p7-ac1024-21500-sab-sat-cuboid-crosscheck-2026-11-11.json; the incidence rows are documented in p7-ac1024-21500-sab-incidence-observation-2026-11-11.json.

implementation.path: drw_extractAcisBodyWireframes detects ACIS BinaryFile 21500, validates the common EntityType/attribute-Pointer/entity-ID prefix and exact pointer-row widths for rooted geometry record families, creates an internal view omitting only the common attribute-pointer slot, then calls the existing 21800 rooted geometry walker. Node identity and record tokens stay unchanged. Public graph-link and failure pointer ordinals are restored to the source 21500 rows.
implementation.atomicRefusal: Malformed common attribute references or pointer-row widths refuse before projection; generated mismatch control verifies cleared output and InvalidModel.
scopeLimits: This normalization is admitted only for the exact observed 21500 row shapes; it is not a version-wide ACIS schema declaration.
Common attribute-pointer dependencies are not part of the rooted geometry projection or graph-link list.
The output reports geometry graph observations only. It does not check B-rep validity, apply transforms or units, or establish native/kernel acceptance.
The source header's third integer remains semantically unqualified; bodyCount is derived from observed body records, not that integer.
The slice does not close the containing DWG entity/owner/AcDs join, other SAB bodies, whole-source graph closure, or DWG/DXF output.

generatedControl.origin: Constructed from scratch in tests/graph_preservation_tests.cpp; no external fixture file.
generatedControl.positive: ACIS 21500 prefixed rooted body graph preserves root/node identities, projects expected vertices/faces, reports closed and reciprocal coedge links, identifies the deliberately discontinuous one-coedge endpoint chain, and exposes the body-to-lump graph link at source pointer ordinal 2.
generatedControl.negative: A model/reference mismatch for the common attribute pointer refuses atomically and returns InvalidModel.

sourceProbe.result: PASS: one rooted body; 85 reachable geometry-graph nodes; 8 vertices, 12 edges, 6 faces; all six loops closed, reciprocal, endpoint-continuous and owner-index matched.
sourceProbe.independence: Probe links the current libdxfrw build and is an implementation observation, not independent semantic evidence.

unresolved: Independent producer/schema evidence for this ACIS 21500 rooted-row normalization.
The excluded attribute-pointer metadata graph and complete ACIS/AcDS source association.
Transform, unit, surface/curve parameter, trim, orientation and B-rep validity semantics.
Direct source-to-B-rep lift, independent-kernel/native CAD acceptance, strict output and platform qualification.
claimEffect: Adds a narrow rooted geometry graph projection for one observed AC1024/ACIS 21500 profile. Does not promote ACIS/ACDS, 3D, DWG, or DXF support claims.
